title: Watch the agent think
question: Three views of option B: the agent's recorded reasoning streams live, and tool calls show their arguments the way Pi shows them. Inbox and agents now share one left column so the conversation gets about 250px more width. Content is illustrative. “Build this” records design preference only; production code is unchanged.

options.label: Reasoning streams in the live turn
options.thesis: The current thought streams at the live edge; earlier thoughts fold to their first line, and tool calls read like Pi: $ command, read path, output preview.
options.viewport: 1600 × 1000, live turn visible; the dock stays hidden.
options.risk: Claude reasoning is long prose; the history must follow the live edge without jumping while the owner reads.

options.label: Read history; the dock keeps streaming
options.thesis: A finished turn keeps its full Pi-style work stream behind one summary line. When the live turn leaves the viewport, the dock streams the newest reasoning lines.
options.viewport: 1600 × 1000, reading an earlier turn with one inbox item waiting.
options.risk: The dock clamps to two lines; a fast stream must not make it flicker.

options.label: A running command in a narrow window
options.thesis: A GPT worker's headline-style reasoning reads as step titles, and the running command shows its live output tail.
options.viewport: 900 × 800; todos fold into a tab, inbox and agents stay in the left column.
options.risk: Long commands and output must wrap inside the history, never widen the page.
